command:
timing_output=$1
shift
TIMEFORMAT=$'wall_seconds=%R\nuser_seconds=%U\nsystem_seconds=%S'
{ time "$@" 2>&3; } 3>&2 2>"$timing_output"
timed_status=$?
printf 'exit=%s\n' "$timed_status" >>"$timing_output"
exit "$timed_status"

limits: Four fresh-process pairs per comparison; paired log-t95 df3 and exact paired median bootstrap, without multiplicity correction.
Official workload runs all20 suites/58 actions. Persistent workflows are a separate experiment and have no official score.
Observed kernel VmHWM is not post-GC live memory; two-second sampled RSS is secondary and all observations are retained.
Uninstrumented application timings use default production features. Optional Cranelift scalar-loop gains do not justify enabling it.
Unrelated user activity, including The Bazaar, was explicitly permitted. Owned builds/tests/profiles/visuals do not overlap timing.
Full raw logs, sources, binaries, screenshots and failed attempts remain in the local evidence directory; large profiling artifacts are not embedded here.
